subject: Launch window negotiation + doc prioritization for Acme Analytics rollout
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Acme roll — confirm target window and docs gaps

Team,

Quick kickoff for Acme Analytics (ACME-3471). They told Sales they expect GA in the first week of December; legal and procurement are still finalizing the SOW, but procurement flagged a compressed timeline. Two asks from my side:

1) Can Product and Eng confirm whether the December 4–8 window is feasible with the current staging → canary → prod sequence?
2) We need a prioritized list of enablement artifacts so Customer Success can start packaging training and the one-pager for their internal stakeholders.

I've attached an initial MVP-rollout-matrix.xlsx — please annotate column "blockers" by EOD Friday. Marcus, call out any infra exceptions (KV cache warm, quantized model parity) that would force a later window. Dev, flag any nontrivial API contract changes. Rishi, if this has any SLA implications, advise.

Thanks — laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Program Management, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Acme roll — confirm target window and docs gaps

Thanks Laura — quick note. We're still tracking a minor contract-change in the inference API (optional metadata header) that landed in staging yesterday. If Acme needs guaranteed parity for the header semantics, we should plan for an additional compatibility shim and push canary by ~72 hours.

I'll add that as a "dependency" in the matrix and mark the effort as small but with a one-week lead if we do the shim.

- Dev

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Acme roll — confirm target window and docs gaps

Context from Infra: two things to call out as exceptions that could block the proposed week:

- KV cache cold-start for long-prefix evals: if Acme's average session prefix exceeds 1024 tokens on day-0, we will see latency spikes. Mitigation: pre-warm cache by replaying the top 10k historical prompts (requires SRE job + storage access). Estimated work: 2 engineers, 2 days.
- Quantized model parity: our quantized 4-bit variant shows a subtle reranking shift on reranking benchmarks; not a hard failure but Acme's analytics workflow relies on deterministic ordering for a dashboard use-case. Option: run the canary on full-precision in the dedicated pool for the first 48 hours. Impact: cost up ~20% for that period.

I'll add details to the matrix and attach SOC2-evidence-index.pdf for their security team.

— Marcus

On Fri, Nov 1, 2028 at 11:03 AM Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Laura...
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: shifted window + prioritized docs for a safe GA

Folks — thanks for the quick updates. Synthesizing:

- Dev's API header shim is a small dev task but could add ~72 hours.
- Marcus's parity/cost tradeoffs suggest a low-risk canary that runs FP (full-precision) for 48h to avoid reordering regressions.

Proposal (decision request):
1) Move canary start out by 5 business days: target canary kickoff on Nov 28, with controlled ramp to GA between Dec 6–8. This gives time for the shim + pre-warm job if Acme opts in.
2) Prioritize enablement artifacts: (A) Customer one-pager (draft-customer-comm.md) — high priority; (B) Runbook for SRE pre-warm procedure; (C) Updated API contract notes with migration checklist. CS will own the one-pager; Eng will own the runbook; Product will own the API notes.
3) Approvals: Laura to confirm procurement timing; Rishi to confirm SLA/credit exposure for FP canary cost.

If there's alignment, I'll lock the plan and send a short note to Acme with the revised dates and mitigation options.

- Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Product Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Patel <sara@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Partner Docs Team <docs@acme-partners.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T17:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: shifted window + prioritized docs for a safe GA

Grace — thanks for pulling this together. Acme prefers an earlier ramp if possible (Dec 1–4) because they have internal stakeholders locked in for the first week of December. Two notes from our side:

1) Procurement is still on track to sign the SOW this week, but legal wants the SOC2 evidence index before they finalize. Marcus, appreciate the PDF; can you also include the subprocess mapping for data residency?
2) If the header shim is required for parity, we could accept the 72-hour delay if Redwood can offer a 10% credit on the first-month usage to offset schedule risk for Acme's internal launch comms.

Granting a small credit will make the shifted window palatable; otherwise we need to push our internal events.

— Sara
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@acmeanalytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-03T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: shifted window + prioritized docs for a safe GA

Summary and next steps (decision locked for internal):

- Internal decision: accept Dev's 72-hour shim lead time and plan canary kickoff Nov 28, GA target Dec 6–8. This gives margin for SRE pre-warm and a 48h FP canary.
- Commercial ask: we can offer a one-time 10% credit on the first-month billed usage if Sales/Finance approve — Laura, can you coordinate sign-off and confirm by EOD Monday?
- Docs owners: CS/Laura — customer one-pager due Nov 15; Eng/Marcus — pre-warm runbook due Nov 22; Product/Grace — API migration checklist due Nov 17. I'll update the rollout matrix with owners and link the drafts.

Grace will send the external note to Acme with the revised dates and the optional credit offer once Laura confirms procurement status. Thanks everyone for fast triage.
